title: Chapter 146 Peak Of The Mortal Realm
content:
Chapter 146 Peak Of The Mortal Realm

Feeling the palpitating breath coming from the unknown star field, Yan Lingyun in that life did not hesitate and entered the unknown star field alone.

Even though she knew that no one who entered the unknown star field had ever come out alive.

"Hehe, another one is here to die."

As soon as she entered the unknown star field, an evil voice sounded from the field.

Hearing this voice, Yan Lingyun frowned slightly.

"I'll give you three breaths of time, get out of here immediately!"

Accompanied by Yan Lingyun's unique breath, the voice continued to spread from all around.

At this time, the surrounding environment was completely different from the outside world.

Everything seemed to have no spirituality.

This is not a place where normal creatures can survive.

There was silence in the field for a moment, and the surroundings seemed even more weird.

"I haven't seen such an arrogant person for a long time."

The space in front of him suddenly cracked.

The next moment, an illusory figure suddenly appeared in the field.

Seeing such a strange creature, Yan Lingyun's face, which was already slightly angry, became even colder.

"You are the one who made the noise here, right?"

Yan Lingyun's cold voice slowly sounded.

Hearing this, the creature burst into laughter.

"Yes, it's me."

"What I want to do is to lead my tribe to devour everything. Everything in this world should belong to..."

The ferocious voice kept coming out of his mouth, but the words were not finished.

Bang!

His figure suddenly retreated violently, and a foul-smelling liquid slowly overflowed from his body.

Yan Lingyun retracted her fist lightly on the spot.

She had nothing to say about the unknown cattle and horses in front of her.

"You!"

"Very good, woman, you have successfully attracted the anger of my Soul Devouring Clan!"

Shi Chen looked at Yan Lingyun in the distance with a ferocious face.

The anger in his heart kept gushing out.

He hadn't been so angry for a long time.

At this moment, he only hoped that the woman in front of him had some strength, otherwise, it would be boring to die directly.

"Soul Devouring Clan?"

At this time, Yan Lingyun looked at Shi Chen who was still chattering in the distance, and suddenly murmured.

Yan Lingyun had no impression of the Soul Devouring Clan.

It can only be said that there are all kinds of things in the world.

"Why, are you afraid of hearing the name of my Soul Devouring Clan?"

"Huh, what a pity, it's too late!"

Shi Chen continued to taunt at this moment.

He really hopes to see a trace of fear in Yan Lingyun's eyes, even if it's just a little bit.

That's what he likes to see the most.

It's a pity that there is no such thing.

In the distance, Yan Lingyun shook her head slightly. She no longer had any desire to communicate with the Soul Devouring Clan creatures in front of her.

"Soul Devouring Clan, right? From now on, it doesn't need to exist."

Yan Lingyun said in a light voice.

The next moment, a terrifying breath suddenly rushed out of her body.

Boom!

In just a moment, the entire space was shattered.

However, the terrifying thing was that the fluctuations did not end, but began to spread in all directions.

Seeing this scene, Shi Chen was stunned in place.

Then, a trace of fear slowly emerged from the depths of his eyes.

This woman really wants to destroy this place!

Crazy!

At this time, Yan Lingyun's eyes suddenly looked at him.

Suddenly, a strong sense of crisis rose from his heart.

Invincible.

Run!

Shi Chen did not hesitate, turned around and ran away.

"Heh, it's too late to escape now."

With a bang, Yan Lingyun rushed directly in the direction of Shi Chen.

The speed was extremely terrifying.

Shi Chen, who was desperately running away, noticed the movement behind him and showed a wave of looking back at the moon!

Nima!!

"Do you really not take my Soul Devouring Clan seriously?!!"

Shi Chen roared while running away.

However, Yan Lingyun was not moved at all, and the killing intent in her eyes became even stronger.

Seeing that Yan Lingyun had no intention of letting him go, Shi Chen's expression became ferocious.

Buzz——

The space began to distort, and Shi Chen's speed suddenly began to surge.

Chase, if you don't chase, I'm still a little unhappy.

In this way, the two chased each other and soon reached the hinterland of the place where the Soul Devouring Clan was located.

Soul Devouring Realm!

Here, it looks like nothingness, but it is filled with a large number of strange buildings.

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly stopped, turned his head and looked to the side with cold eyes.

Swish!

The space cracked, and a huge figure slowly stepped out of it.

His aura made the surrounding space tremble constantly.

"You want to destroy my Soul Devouring Clan?"

A vicious voice sounded.

Boom!

Suddenly, the surrounding space began to buzz.

Countless Soul Devouring Clan members suddenly appeared in the field.

There are tens of millions of them, and at this moment, the number of Soul Devourers is still increasing!

Looking at the almost endless Soul Devourers around, Yan Lingyun couldn't help but look serious.

"Hahahaha, you want to destroy my Soul Devourer, what do you think you are!"

At this time, Shi Chen suddenly appeared in the field again.

"Master Ren, this woman doesn't take my Soul Devourer seriously at all, kill her!"

Looking at Shi Chen's disgusting face, Yan Lingyun's eyes were filled with murderous intent.

"Die!"

With a bang!

A force of incomparable dominance went straight towards Shi Chen.

Sensed by the horror of this force, countless Soul Devourers present were immediately horrified.

There are such strong men in the outside world!

The Soul Devourer named Shi Ren also looked solemn.

Bang!

An explosion sounded.

Shi Ren suddenly stood in front of Shi Chen and blocked Yan Lingyun's attack.

Peak of the Mortal Realm!

Seeing the opponent's strength, even Yan Lingyun couldn't help but frown slightly.

If such an existence were to go to the outside world, it would definitely be an unrivaled existence.

At that time, the Endless Star Region would definitely be devastated.

Thinking of this, Yan Lingyun slowly clenched his fists.

At the same time, a terrifying breath slowly overflowed from his body.

It was the same breath as that of Shi Ren.

"Peak of the Mortal Realm, how is it possible!"

On the side, Shi Chen suddenly lost his voice.

His eyes were full of disbelief.

In his opinion, such a strong person would not appear except for their Soul Devouring Clan.

Could it be that this woman is a Soul Devouring Clan in human skin?

It must be said that Shi Chen's brain circuit is very strange.

If Yan Lingyun knew this idea, it might not be enough to kill Shi Chen ten thousand times.

"Lord Ren, what should we do now?"

At this moment, Shi Chen had already had a hint of retreat.

Hearing Shi Chen's words, Shi Ren's face was heavy.

"Let the other tribesmen retreat first!"

"All those above the God Breaking Realm stay."

With only Yan Lingyun, Shi Ren was still very confident.

If so many people can't take down one person, then their Soul Devouring Clan will be embarrassed.

The voice fell.

The Soul Devouring Clan members around him immediately began to slowly retreat.

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly walked towards them.
